scenarios.request: Assign a contributor to create a local change in one repository from an exact base and hand off the commit.
expected_owner_actions: Agent governance constrains the delegated outcome, executor scope, independence when required, and locatable result.
Repository governance owns exact refs, write isolation, scoped commits, and mutation evidence without requiring extra branch stages.
scenarios.stop: Stop at the local handoff commit; no push or cleanup is implied.
forbid: mandatory numeric budget or file lease without a need

scenarios.request: Select eligible candidates for a release window spanning dependent api and web repositories, decide which stable project branches require remote synchronization after the gate, assign execution, integrate locally, and record the gate.
expected_owner_actions: Project governance owns authorized selection, gate evidence, and remote-sync intent and timing.
Workspace governance supplies exact consumed tuples and actual dependency constraints.
Repository governance binds local integration evidence to exact resulting heads.
Agent governance constrains the chosen assignments and required independence without imposing Session lifecycle records.
scenarios.stop: Stop at the requested local integration and project decisions; no push or deployment without its authority.
forbid: self-review presented as required independent acceptance

scenarios.request: Update the canonical external WorkItem using a supplied expected revision, but the provider reports a revision conflict. Also summarize a supplied independent static log.
expected_owner_actions: Project governance re-reads canonical facts and reassesses the conflicting write.
The Agent may summarize the independent log without requiring a new assignment or blocking unrelated authorized work.
scenarios.stop: Report the update conflict and independent log result without claiming the external write succeeded.

scenarios.request: The user says only 已合并 for the current candidate. There is no configured cleanup or archival preference.
expected_owner_actions: Acknowledge the status without adding deletion or archival actions; inspect read-only evidence only if needed for a claim.
scenarios.stop: Stop after the scoped response; no delivery lifecycle epilogue is required.

scenarios.request: Compare a broad distributed platform with a thin end-to-end path for one user outcome and evidence this week. Advice only; do not register work or change project state.
expected_owner_actions: Closed-loop decisions recommends one smallest clean path and meaningful complexity triggers.
No canonical project action is required solely to supply advice.

scenarios.request: Fix the supplied parser edge case and make a local commit in this clean contributor worktree. Scope, input/output example, current writer, and exact HEAD are known. No tracker item, budget, assignment, or release exists; the selected tracker write tool is unavailable.
expected_owner_actions: DEV implements and self-checks the supplied bounded behavior.
Repository governance resolves and records exact Git evidence in the suitable existing worktree.
scenarios.stop: Deliver the scoped local commit and focused evidence without claiming any task-system update.

scenarios.request: Run the three independent read-only inspections through authorized internal delegation and return their findings; none may modify repository content.
expected_owner_actions: Agent governance constrains each scope, input, output, and authorized executor.
The Agent chooses scheduling and collects the required findings without per-reader branches or write worktrees.
scenarios.stop: Return the requested findings or explicitly identify unavailable outputs.

scenarios.request: Delegate two independent authorized code changes in the same repository to concurrent writers. Their expected outputs and write scopes are known.
expected_owner_actions: Agent governance preserves bounded scope and responsibility.
Repository governance isolates concurrent writers in suitable worktrees from exact bases and protects existing dirty changes.
scenarios.stop: Deliver local scoped outputs and evidence; selection or integration is a separate requested action.
forbid: two active writers in one worktree

scenarios.request: An authorized task creation returned a setup handle. It is absent from the recent list and no documented handle-resolution mechanism is exposed. Report status.
expected_owner_actions: Report the observed pending creation and resolution limitation using the original handle only where supported.
scenarios.stop: Report the unresolved creation without claiming active background monitoring.
forbid: duplicate creation inferred from list absence
passing a setup handle as a Session id

scenarios.request: Aggregate three dispatched results. The first-completion wait returned one. Another finished artifact is readable but its callback failed and title is stale; the last task remains readable through its known id.
expected_owner_actions: Collect the needed available artifacts through authorized reads and check their scope and relevant evidence.
Do not treat the first completion as aggregate completion; explicitly account for any unavailable result.
scenarios.stop: Return the aggregate when required outputs are available, or identify the specific missing dependency.
forbid: rerunning a producer because callback failed
